race.comment: AETERNUM (2) was well found last start at Gosford after a strong run at Wyong but failed to follow it up in tough conditions. Is sure to hunt forward again and will find this a bit easier. Leading player. EXCEED ME (8) is on a quick turnaround after a solid third at Taree 10 days ago where he was well supported. Drawn out but is nearing his top now and looms a genuine threat. ZOUCAT (10) produced a better run last start, beaten 2.25 lengths into sixth over 1100m at Grafton. Gets in well again with the 2kg claim and could fill a minor spot at a nice quote. THE MAGIC MAN (5) boasts peaks that measure up and gets his chance to play a more significant role.
